tools.name: clify_sites
tools.description: Search the catalogue of 135 real websites clify can call (package registries, government data, science, news, jobs, weather, culture…). Pass a keyword query to get the best sites with their matching commands. Without a query it pages through the catalogue, one line per site ("name (category, command

tools.name: clify_help
tools.description: A site's commands with params ("name*" = required, ":a|b" = allowed values, "=x" = default). Pass command for full param docs, default fields and a ready clify_run call.

tools.name: clify_run
tools.description: Call one command of a clify site and get JSON back. args holds the command's params (see clify_help). Lists return count, total and nextPage (args for the next page). Write commands return a dry-run preview unless confirm:true.

tools.name: crates__get-crate
tools.description: crates.io: Get a crate's details: description, links, download totals, keywords, categories and default version Returns name, description, default_version, downloads, recent_downloads, num_versions, keywords, categories, repository, documentation, homepage, updated_at by default. (Same as clify_run

tools.name: pypi__get-package
tools.description: pypi.org: Get a package's PyPI page for its latest version: name and version, summary, pip install command, project links and metadata sidebar, and README text. Returns name_version, summary, pip_command, sidebar, description by default. (Same as clify_run site=pypi command=get-package.)

tools.name: wikipedia__summary
tools.description: en.wikipedia.org: Short summary of an article (title, description, extract, url) Returns title, description, extract, content_urls.desktop.page by default. (Same as clify_run site=wikipedia command=summary.)

tools.name: hnsearch__search
tools.description: hn.algolia.com: Search stories/comments by relevance Returns title, points, num_comments, author, created_at, url, objectID by default. (Same as clify_run site=hnsearch command=search.)

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "clify_run" appears informational but accepts parameters (command) that enable code/file/secret access.
